unbroken_generator.reading: U has no weak-isospin component and a nonzero color component; electric charge Q_em = T3 + Y has a weak-isospin component and no color component, so U is not Q_em in any normalization.

ray_symmetries.reading: an electric charge n.T + Y leaves the ray invariant only if n.T does (Y = Q/6 acts as a scalar); the intersection with weak su(2) is zero, so no electric-charge direction does

electric_charge.proof: the qubit-block generator n.sigma/2 + 1/2 must act as a scalar on the 2-dim support; its traceless part n.sigma/2 is nonzero for every unit n
